# warptap

> Open-source Python library that inserts IEEE 1149.1 (JTAG/TAP) and IEEE 1687 (IJTAG) test-access networks into RTL, emits ICL and PDL, and generates SVF, STAPL and STIL patterns.

## Docs
- [Quickstart](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/warptap/quickstart/): install and insert a first IJTAG network
- [Nested SIB networks](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/warptap/guide/nested-sib-networks/): a SIB gating a nested sub-network
- [Multi-arm ScanMux](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/warptap/guide/scan-mux/): N-arm ScanMux segments
- [Named sub-field addressing](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/warptap/guide/field-addressing/): reading and writing part of an instrument by name
- [ICL / PDL import](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/warptap/guide/icl-pdl-import/): reading ICL and PDL back in
- [System-clock pulsing](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/warptap/guide/sck-clock-pulsing/): pulsing a functional clock from PDL (-sck)
- [Faultflow pattern retargeting](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/warptap/guide/faultflow-retargeting/): driving faultflow scan patterns through the network
- [API reference](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/warptap/reference/): every public function and class
- [Changelog](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/warptap/changelog/)

## Related
- [faultflow](https://github.com/ranaumarnadeem/faultflow): ATPG and fault simulation
- [autoMBIST](https://github.com/ranaumarnadeem/autoMBIST): MBIST, BIRA and BISR generator
- [OpenTestability](https://github.com/ranaumarnadeem/OpenTestability): testability analysis and test point insertion
